description: Test suite for subscription-related store functions in the focalboard project, including creation, deletion, retrieval, and counting of subscriptions and subscribers.

methods.name: StoreTestSubscriptionsStore
methods.description: Main test function that runs sub-tests for creating, deleting, undeleting, and retrieving subscriptions.

methods.name: testCreateSubscription
methods.description: Tests creating subscriptions, including duplicate and invalid cases.

methods.name: testDeleteSubscription
methods.description: Tests deleting subscriptions and handling non-existent deletions.

methods.name: testUndeleteSubscription
methods.description: Tests re-creating a previously deleted subscription.

methods.name: testGetSubscription
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific subscription and handling non-existent cases.

methods.name: testGetSubscriptions
methods.description: Tests retrieving all subscriptions for a user.

methods.name: testGetSubscribersForBlock
methods.description: Tests retrieving subscribers for a block and counting them.
